questions.q:
Consider the following statements about cryptography.
I. In symmetric key cryptography, the same key is used for encryption and decryption.
II. In asymmetric key cryptography, the same key is used for encryption and decryption.
Which of the above is/are correct?
questions.e: Only I is correct. Symmetric ciphers such as DES and AES share one secret key. Asymmetric ciphers use a key pair, a public key and a private key.

questions.q: Which of the following is an asymmetric (public key) algorithm?
questions.e: RSA uses a public and private key pair. DES, AES and RC4 are symmetric ciphers.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements about DES.
I. The effective key size of DES is 64 bits.
II. The block size of DES is 56 bits.
Which of the above is/are correct?
questions.e: Neither is correct. DES has a 64-bit key of which 8 bits are parity, so the effective key is 56 bits. The block size is 64 bits.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT a function of a firewall?
o: Filtering traffic according to security rules
Blocking unauthorised access from an untrusted network
Protecting an internal network from outside threats
questions.e: Assigning IP addresses is the job of DHCP. A firewall allows or blocks traffic between a trusted and an untrusted network.

questions.q: In a digital signature scheme using public key cryptography, the sender signs the message digest using
questions.e: Only the sender knows his private key, so anyone can verify the signature with the sender's public key. This gives authentication and non-repudiation.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements.
I. A phishing attack tries to trick users into revealing confidential information.
II. A virus can replicate by itself over a network without attaching to any host file.
Which of the above is/are correct?
questions.e: Phishing uses fake messages or sites to steal information. The self-replicating network-spreading code with no host file is a worm, not a virus, so II is false.

questions.q: In a Diffie-Hellman exchange with p = 23 and g = 5, Alice has private key 6 and Bob has private key 15. The shared secret key is
questions.e: Alice sends 5⁶ mod 23 = 8 and Bob sends 5¹⁵ mod 23 = 19. The key is 19⁶ mod 23 = 8¹⁵ mod 23 = 2.
